subject: Finly security qualification + evidence checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finly.com>, Ben Owens <ben.owens@finly.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finly security qualification + evidence checklist

Hi Emily / Ben — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. High level: Finly is evaluating Redwood primarily for latency-sensitive fraud analysis and duplicate detection workloads; you need predictable retention controls, an audit-log surface, and SOC 2 evidence for procurement.

Key pain points you shared:
- Data residency & retention: legal requires retention windows configurable per-customer and ability to place logs in a customer-managed bucket.
- Auditability: security team needs exportable, tamper-evident audit logs with per-token and per-request metadata for seven years.
- SOC 2 evidence: you need a Type II report + artifact list (configurations, change logs, access reviews).
- Pen test: your vendor assessment requires summary results and the remediation timeline for any critical findings.

What we can provide (high level):
- DPA + template: we can share our standard DPA and flag items we typically negotiate (retention, subprocessor list).
- Audit log options: native retention + option to stream logs to a customer S3/GCS bucket (encrypted).
- SOC 2: we can provide the attestation PDF and an artifact catalog for intake.
- Pen-test: redactable executive summary available; full report under NDA if needed.

Action items / owners: 
1) Soojin: send SOC 2 attestation + artifact inventory and DPA draft by EOD today. (attaching SOC2 and DPA draft)
2) Ben / Emily: confirm whether Finly requires vendor-hosted retention or customer-managed bucket (deadline: Fri 07/16).
3) Aditya: prepare pricing note for ded. capacity + potential retention surcharge for long-term storage.
4) Marcus (cc): ready to weigh in on any technical gating / pen-test exceptions.

Attachments included: SOC2-TypeII-Attestation-2026.pdf, dpa-draft-finly-v1.docx

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-Attestation-2026.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: dpa-draft-finly-v1.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Owens <ben.owens@finly.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@finly.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finly security qualification + evidence checklist

Thanks Soojin — this is helpful. Couple of clarifying items: 

1) Retention: our legal team will prefer customer-managed buckets (S3) if the export contains any PII. Is the streaming option immediate (near-real time) or batched? Can you confirm encryption-in-transit details?

2) Audit logs: we need a sample of the schema for the logs (fields we can expect). If possible, include a small anonymized sample.

3) Pen test: curious if you have any critical findings in the last 12 months and how long remediation took (we're OK with NDA for the full report).

I'll sync with legal and aim to confirm the retention choice by Friday. Attaching our vendor security checklist (short).

-Ben
Ben Owens | Head of Procurement, Finly
[Attachment: finly-vendor-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Finly pricing + evidence ask

Soojin — quick internal note following Ben's questions. Pricing sensitivity: Finly called out a steady-state monthly volume with occasional peaks (estimated 1.2M tokens/day average, 6M peak). They will likely want a reserved (dedicated) tier for consistent latency.

For evidence responses:
- I'll draft a short note on retention surcharge options (per-GB/month for long-term audit archives) and how streaming to customer S3 would affect egress/cost.
- Marcus, can you confirm whether we can provide a 7-year retention export on standard accounts vs. a dedicated retention bucket feature (is that GA or gated)?

Also recommended: if Finly insists on full pen-test PDF under NDA, legal will require us to track the exchange in our intake spreadsheet and mark redactions for internal PII.

Aditya

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finly.com>, Ben Owens <ben.owens@finly.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 03:10:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Finly security qualification + evidence checklist

Emily / Ben — appreciate the quick reply and the vendor checklist. Short answers and firm next steps: 

- Retention streaming: we support near-real-time streaming (sub-minute) to a customer S3 bucket; TLS 1.2+ and server-side encryption recommended. We'll include the config sample and presigned-role pattern.
- Audit log schema: attaching a 2-page sample (anonymized) showing request-id, model-id, token-count, timestamp, caller-subject, route, and retention-tag.
- Pen test: we had one critical finding in 2026 (third-party dependency vulnerability). Remediation completed within 28 days; executive summary attached. Full report available under NDA.

Next steps (agreed):
1) Finly to confirm retention approach by Fri 2027-07-16 (customer S3 vs. vendor retention).
2) Redwood to provide: (a) anonymized audit-log sample, (b) retention config doc, (c) SOC2 attestation + artifact inventory, (d) pen-test executive summary. Deliverable ETA: EOD Thu (today).
3) If Finly wants the full pen-test report we will route legal NDA — please indicate and we will start the exchange.

I'll drop the documents into the Drive folder and link them here once uploaded. Feel free to call if you want to walk through the audit-log sample.

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pen-test-executive-summary-2027.txt (text)]
